items.title: Out-of-task access classification change in restricted
items.mechanism: Fixture/code digest matches the source run. sandbox/agent.py forwards explicit /tool commands to Tools.execute; sandbox/tools.py validates roles and argument shapes but receives no legitimate-task policy. runner/scenarios.py supplies that policy to the detector after execution. This supports a missing task-authorization check in the synthetic interface; it does not prove every observation is a distinct root defect.
limitations: Only session-local synthetic state was affected; no external message delivery occurred.
Supplied markers are not evidence of extraction of previously unknown secrets. Separator-encoded input does not establish encoded-secret detection.
This is an observed task-boundary issue, not a live Next.js vulnerability or model exploit.
